title: Zero-config debt report: list every input a fresh user must supply
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Add 'susi doctor --zero-config' that scans the setting registry, env vars, prompts and setup steps and prints each remaining manual input with the task that removes it. Tests zc_debt_report_*.
